Cost: 500eb (Very Expensive) ♦ Install: Clinic

Humanity Loss: 3 (1d6) hi

Braindance wreaths are expensive, ugly, and annoying — plus, who wants to realize they forgot to charge it the night before? With the newest Braindance synchronization cybernetics, such worries are a thing of the past. Great for the alternate reality lovers among us.

Requires two Cybereyes and must be paired. Functions as a Braindance Viewer (CP:R, pg. 352) implanted into the user’s eyes. Braindances must be downloaded via direct connection to the user’s Neuroport or stored on a shard currently inserted into one of the user’s Shard Slots to be viewable by this cyberware.

Type: Cybereye
Install: Clinic
Option Slots: uses 1

Foundry notes:

  • Corgo's document has a typo on this Humanity Loss line; the value is 3 (1d6).

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Cyberware > Cyberoptics).
